settings.headline:
Built for the sea.
Engineered for the job.
settings.intro: Boat building, refurbishment and metal fabrication from a workshop at Kilkeel Harbour. Marine experience. Practical engineering.
settings.story:
A harbour workshop.
A broad engineering capability.
settings.name: Ian Newell Boat Building & Repair Ltd
settings.address: The Harbour, Kilkeel, Co Down, BT34 4AX, Northern Ireland

services.title: Fabrication & Welding
services.short: Metalwork for marine, industrial and bespoke requirements.
services.body: Fabrication and welding in mild steel, stainless steel, aluminium and cast iron. The material range also includes S355, Weldox and Hardox. Share your drawings or application requirements to discuss suitable materials and fabrication.

services.title: Profile Cutting
services.short: Accurate shapes cut for your fabrication requirements.
services.body: Computerised profile cutting for intricate shapes and repeat quantities. Oxy-acetylene and plasma cutting capabilities are listed for metal sheet. Discuss material, sheet size, thickness and quantity with the team before manufacture.

services.title: Folding
services.body: Guillotine and press-brake work for mild steel, stainless steel and aluminium. Computerised measuring and pressure control supports accurate forming for engineered parts and fabrication projects.

services.title: Machining
services.body: CNC lathe and milling capabilities support the supply of production parts for the engineering industry. Send drawings, material requirements and quantities to discuss manufacture.

services.title: Structural Steel
services.body: Structural steelwork for the construction industry, with onsite work including the erection of shuttering and cladding. Discuss drawings, site requirements and installation needs with the team.

sectors.title: Boat Building
sectors.short: Steel and aluminium vessels built to customer requirements.
sectors.body: New steel and aluminium boats built from kits designed to customer specifications. The service includes vessels up to 16.5 metres and shallow-draft, flat-bottom aluminium boats with onboard weighing and grading facilities for shell fishing.

sectors.title: Boat Refurbishment
sectors.short: Interior, exterior and mechanical improvements for working vessels.
sectors.body: Boat refurbishment covering interiors and exteriors, hull repairs, engines, cranes, deck machinery and handling systems. The team also undertakes netdrum work, vessel lengthening and shelter decks.

sectors.title: Navigation Buoys
sectors.short: Fabricated navigation buoys for shipping channels.
sectors.body: Navigation buoys manufactured with a hull-type body and keel. The design provides buoyancy and working space for channel-marking requirements.

sectors.title: Aluminium Fabrication
sectors.short: Marine and transport fabrication in aluminium.
sectors.body: Aluminium fabrication includes fishing vessels, wheelhouses, shelter decks and hatches, alongside prawn washers, conveyors, hoppers and lorry bodies.

sectors.title: Parts Manufacturing
sectors.short: Precision parts for engineering and machinery.
sectors.body: Manufacture and supply of precision parts and equipment for engineering applications. Published examples include forklift parts, farm-machinery parts and components for the construction industry.

sectors.title: Bespoke Manufacturing
sectors.short: Custom metalwork developed around your needs.
sectors.body: Work with the team to design and manufacture bespoke items to meet specific requirements. Share the problem, dimensions and intended use to begin a practical manufacturing discussion.

sectors.title: Farm Machinery
sectors.short: Repairs and modifications for agricultural equipment.
sectors.body: Repairs to farm machinery and changes to existing equipment to extend its capability. Contact the team to discuss the machine, damage or modification required.
